interpretations: Average `driverStandings.wins` across entries with `driverStandings.points > 1`, excluding missing win counts.
Average `driverStandings.wins` across entries with `driverStandings.points >= 1`, excluding missing win counts.
queries:
SELECT AVG(wins)
FROM driverStandings
WHERE points > 1
  AND wins IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(wins)
FROM driverStandings
WHERE points >= 1
  AND wins IS NOT NULL
